answer: A convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders: every task's verdict is decided by a small panel drawn at random only from established identities whose standing is staked, like a canyon separating newcomers from influence. Reputation is ferrous-rich collateral, bonded and slashable, so a fake identity carries no weight until it has survived a long thread of verified work. An attacker must buy or grow thousands of stake-backed histories, and every failed collusion attempt burns that stake, making attacks costlier than honest grading.
